carousel.subject: General Science

questions.q: Sharir ki sabse badi gland kaunsi hai?
questions.why: Liver sharir ki sabse badi gland hoti hai, pachan mein madad karti hai.

questions.q: Khoon ko shuddh karne wala organ kaunsa hai?
questions.why: Kidney khoon se waste padarth nikal kar use shuddh karta hai.

questions.q: Sharir ka sabse bada organ kaunsa hai?
questions.why: Skin (twacha) sharir ka sabse bada aur bahari organ hoti hai.

questions.q: Pachan tantra ka sabse lamba hissa kaunsa hai?
questions.why: Small intestine pachan tantra ka sabse lamba hissa hota hai.

questions.q: Oxygen lekar CO2 bahar nikalne wala organ kaunsa hai?
questions.why: Lungs saans ke dauran oxygen lete hain aur CO2 bahar nikalte hain.
